description: YouBike / Moovo stations whose name or address contains a keyword (Chinese or English), with live bikes and empty docks. Example: city "Taipei", keyword "臺北車站".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, YunlinCounty, Chiayi, ChiayiCounty, PingtungCounty, TaitungCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, 高雄市, ...).

keyword.description: Part of the station name or address, e.g. "市政府" or "Taipei City Hall".

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default 10).

want.description: Same as in youbike_nearby, but defaults to "any".

name: youbike_station
title: Find YouBike stations by name
